Per tipe dokumen: penanda tangan (penggu: Per document type: the signer (a user or a role, one of the two), minimum approval level, AI pre-check required, QR verification required, allow delegation, checksum algorithm (SHA-256 / SHA-512), and Drive archive folder ID.

Jenis dokumen, folder bawaannya, dan apa: Document types, their default folders, and whether the document needs a signature or an AI pre-check.
Folder Shared Drive tujuan untuk setiap: The destination Shared Drive folder for each document type, per entity and division. Make sure every division has its own Shared Drive folder.

Daftar setiap jenis notifikasi dengan ko: The list of every notification type with "In the app" and "Email" columns. Admins can turn email on or off per notification; the admin's choice overrides the default rules. Click "Restore default" to go back.
Email hanya untuk yang menunggu keputusa: Email is only for things that are waiting for a decision or action, where a delay is costly. Too many emails cause important ones to be missed.
